name: Snatch and Grab
summary: At Jerod's Landing, Master Mathias Shaw sends agents to learn how the Defias move their supplies. The Brotherhood uses the river dock to ship goods in secret.

sections.title: A Test of Tradecraft
sections.body: Master Mathias Shaw tests those who seek a place among Stormwind's covert agents. He asks for finesse and stealth, not brute force. SI:7 agents quietly take down key figures and recover important papers. They do this without drawing the realm into open scandal. Each new operative must prove they can work unseen.

sections.title: Smugglers on the River
sections.body: Jerod's Landing sits on the river in southern Elwynn, south of Goldshire and just east of the Maclure Vineyards. The Defias Brotherhood seized the once-quiet dock and turned it into an illicit route. Arms, supplies, and contraband cross the water from Redridge toward Westfall. Royal road patrols cannot reach them there.

sections.title: Plausible Deniability
sections.body: Master Mathias Shaw warns agents that capture, compromise, or death leaves them without the Crown's support. Stormwind and its spymasters will deny they ever existed. The Defias Dockmaster's schedule gives SI:7 proof of the Brotherhood's supply lines. Recovering it keeps Stormwind's official involvement hidden.

faq.q: Who assigns the quest Snatch and Grab?
faq.answer: Master Mathias Shaw, leader of Stormwind's intelligence service SI:7, assigns the work from its headquarters in Old Town.
Jerod's Landing is a river dock in southern Elwynn Forest, south of Goldshire and just east of the Maclure Vineyards. The Defias Brotherhood controls the docks and dock house.

faq.q: What are the Defias smuggling through Jerod's Landing?
faq.answer: The Defias move contraband and supplies across the water between Redridge and Westfall, beyond kingdom watchposts and road checkpoints.

faq.q: Who carries the Defias Shipping Schedule?
faq.answer: The Defias Dockmaster carries the shipping schedule and guards the dock house at Jerod's Landing.

faq.q: What happens if an operative is captured during this mission?
faq.answer: Master Mathias Shaw warns that SI:7 will deny any connection to an operative who is exposed or captured.

faq.q: Why does SI:7 care about this shipping schedule?
faq.answer: The schedule details how the Defias Brotherhood moves contraband between Redridge and Westfall. It lets Stormwind's intelligence network map the enemy's supply lines without alerting the syndicate.

angles.text: As a rogue, you meet SI:7 and prove your stealth and cutpurse instincts. Earn Mathias Shaw's recognition and a signature blade.
As an Alliance member, you help intercept Defias supplies at Jerod's Landing. That protects Elwynn Forest and weakens the criminal syndicate threatening Stormwind's surrounding territories.
